description: This file is a PHP web page that provides a user interface for viewing and managing troubleshooting logs, including system, event, and firewall logs, with dynamic filtering and AJAX-based data loading.

methods.name: adjust_acs_tb
methods.description: Adjusts the table headers and summaries for the visible data table based on provided column headers.

methods.name: ajaxDo
methods.description: Performs an AJAX request to fetch logs data based on mode and time frame, then populates the corresponding table.
